uniqueness: Three distinct coaches, and distinctness is enforced on the OFFENSIVE IDENTITY and the DEFENSIVE SHELL — the two things the user actually reads.
flatBonuses: none — a coach's effect emerges from roster supply, system demands, opponent interaction and era legality

sample.roleBlurb: Best deploys what this roster already does well.
sample.name: Stan Van Gundy
sample.offense: Runs a perimeter-spacing offense — plays through the arc.
sample.central: Terry Porter creates the advantage; Austin Reaves and Ace Bailey space the floor behind it.
sample.targets: This roster's best asset is perimeter scoring, and this staff is built to use it.
sample.defense: Man-to-man defense under the era's illegal-defense rules, dropping the big in coverage.
sample.era: This environment sits between the extremes, and the system translates without major friction.
sample.sacrifice: If the shots do not fall, there is no second way to score.

sample.roleBlurb: Built to attack the other side's biggest problem.
sample.name: Red Auerbach
sample.offense: Runs a transition offense — runs at every opportunity.
sample.central: Terry Porter pushes off every miss, with Austin Reaves running the lane.
sample.targets: Built around one job: make Charles Barkley give the ball up, and live with whoever is left.
sample.defense: Man-to-man defense under the era's illegal-defense rules, loading up help early.
sample.era: This environment sits between the extremes, and the system translates without major friction.
sample.sacrifice: Playing this fast concedes shot quality and offensive-rebounding position.

sample.roleBlurb: Best translates this roster into tonight's rules.
sample.name: Phil Jackson
sample.offense: Runs a post-up offense — works through the post.
sample.central: Elton Brand works from the block; the other four space and cut off him.
sample.targets: This staff's structure travels into this rule set without needing to be rebuilt.
sample.defense: Man-to-man defense under the era's illegal-defense rules, containing without gambling.
sample.era: This environment sits between the extremes, and the system translates without major friction.
sample.sacrifice: Feeding the post slows the game and invites help to load up inside.
